items.text: The firm reported 20,514 financial advisors at period end as of June 26, 2026.
The firm reported an average of 20,537 financial advisors for the second quarter of 2026.
The firm reported 20,425 financial advisors at year end December 31, 2025.
The firm reports financial advisors by segment; at year end December 31, 2025 it reported 19,540 financial advisors in the U.S.
The firm reports financial advisors by segment; at year end December 31, 2025 it reported 885 financial advisors in Canada.
The consolidated financial statements are presented in dollars in millions, except per unit information and the number of financial advisors.
